ja.title: 楽しくて奇妙な物語: ゲームをしよう
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。写真 / Xiao Luo 先週末、私は友人のXiaobaiを毎週プレイするように招待しました。小白はまだミニプログラムの猿ゲームをしていると言って、しばらく待ってほしいと言いました。 「WeChat アプレット?」彼はゲームのスクリーンショットを送った。縦長の画面で、スタイルは非常に古く、子供の頃にネットサーフィンをしているときに表示されるウェブゲームの広告のようなものでした。 「私はこのゲームを長い間プレイしてきました」と彼は言いました。このゲームは「パニックにならないでください、シティロード」と呼ばれています。古代をテーマにしたタワーディフェンスゲームです。確認できる情報は、2026 年の第 2 四半期の発売以降、市場は好調で、かつては WeChat ミニゲームのベストセラーのトップ 3 に入っていたということです。 WeChat ミニゲームは徐々に巨大な市場になりました。 2026年のWeChatミニゲーム開発者カンファレンスで公開された情報によると、WeChatミニゲームの月間アクティブユーザー数は安定して5億人を超え、ユーザーの粘着性は上昇し続けており、1日の平均ゲーム時間は60分を超えています。無意識にミニプログラムゲームをプレイしているようです。

en.title: Fun and strange stories: play some games
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Photo / Xiao Luo Last weekend, I invited my friend Xiaobai to play weekly. Xiaobai asked me to wait for a while, saying that he was still playing the mini program monkey game. "WeChat applet?" He sent a screenshot of the game. It was vertical screen and the style was very old, just like the kind of web game advertisements that would pop up when surfing the Internet when I was a child. "I've been playing this game for a long time," he said. This game is called "Don't Panic, City Lord". It is an ancient-themed tower defense game. The information that can be found is that the market performed well after its launch in the second quarter of 2026, and it was once among the top three best-selling WeChat mini games. WeChat Mini Games has gradually become a huge market. According to information disclosed at the 2026 WeChat Mini Game Developer Conference, the number of monthly active users of WeChat Mini Games has stably exceeded 500 million, user stickiness continues to rise, and the average daily game time exceeds 60 minutes. It seems that I am playing mini-program games unconsciously.

en.title: Outside the gym where "Operation Delta" anchors the top game, waiting for someone I see on my phone every day
en.summary: On the afternoon of August 2, I just left the ChinaJoy venue and turned around to the Shanghai Baoshan Stadium. It is now 3 o'clock in the afternoon, and there are still 3 hours before the start of the S2 finals of the "Operation Delta" Anchor Summit. It had just rained, the sun was not too poisonous, and the humid air gave people a sticky heat. At this time, many people had gathered outside the venue, and there was a long queue at the ticket check-in area. Many viewers came for the anchor's interactive session. There were also many viewers who had not grabbed tickets, leaning on the railings and looking at the anchor's signature area. Long queue at the ticket check-in area Tickets for this finals were not easy to buy, and all 2,200 external seats were sold out within 5 seconds of the ticket opening. I started chatting with these people who were coming to the event without buying tickets. Acker stood in the crowd of people who didn't get tickets. From time to time, he took out his mobile phone and raised it above his head, trying to capture the anchors who were signing autographs for fans. Ake is from Jiangsu. He studied in college in Changchun and spent time in Shanghai during the holidays.

We are stepping up preparations and striving to replenish the goods as soon as possible. Please wait for a while." "Quiet Pastoral" was released on July 30. This game is a rural life simulation game created by the "Yemei" development team. Players will incarnate as children who have settled in Hetsin Village (Hetsugu Village) and live freely in the village with a strange atmosphere everywhere: cultivating farmland, raising livestock, interacting with villagers, fishing and leisure. items.title: 任天堂博物馆累计参观人数突破100万人次
items.summary: 任天堂博物馆官方社媒账号宣布累计参观人数已突破100万人次。 官方发文称：“截至206年7月底，任天堂博物馆累计参观人数已突破100万人次。自2024年10月开业以来，有众多来宾光临本馆，我们衷心表示感谢。今后也请多多支持任天堂博物馆。” 任天堂博物馆是2024年10月2日开业的任天堂资料馆，人们可以在此了解迄今为止任天堂发售的玩具、游戏的历史，还能尝试只能在这里体验的、为多数过去产品为原型重新改编设计的独特游戏。2026年秋季，博物馆还将开放新的餐饮设施 “SUPER FAMILY RESTAURANT” 。目前，想进入该博物馆参观，仍需要预约加抽选。

ja.title: 任天堂ミュージアムの累計来場者数が100万人を突破
ja.summary: 任天堂博物館の公式SNSアカウントは、累計来場者数が100万人を突破したと発表した。公式声明では「任天堂ミュージアムは、2020年7月末現在、累計来館者数が100万人を突破しました。2024年10月の開館以来、多くのお客様にご来館いただき、心より感謝申し上げます。今後とも任天堂ミュージアムをよろしくお願いいたします。」と述べられている。任天堂ミュージアムは、2024年10月2日にオープンする任天堂の博物館です。任天堂がこれまでに発売したおもちゃやゲームの歴史を学ぶことができます。過去の数々の作品のプロトタイプをアレンジした、ここでしか体験できないユニークなゲームも体験できます。 2026年秋には新たな飲食施設「SUPER FAMILY RESTAURANT」もオープンする。現在も入場するには予約と抽選が必要だ。

en.title: Cumulative number of visitors to Nintendo Museum exceeds 1 million
en.summary: The official social media account of the Nintendo Museum announced that the cumulative number of visitors has exceeded 1 million. An official statement stated: "As of the end of July 2020, the cumulative number of visitors to the Nintendo Museum has exceeded 1 million. Since its opening in October 2024, many guests have visited the museum. We sincerely express our gratitude. Please support the Nintendo Museum in the future." The Nintendo Museum is a Nintendo museum that will open on October 2, 2024. Here, people can learn about the history of toys and games released by Nintendo so far. They can also try unique games that can only be experienced here and are adapted from prototypes of many past products. In the fall of 2026, the museum will also open a new dining facility "SUPER FAMILY RESTAURANT". Currently, if you want to enter the museum, you still need to make an appointment and participate in a lottery.

items.title: BOOOMSeek 评选结果出炉，五大奖项揭晓！

items.title: 世嘉正式设立世嘉（上海）软件有限公司
items.summary: 世嘉于日前宣布，正式在中国上海成立世嘉（上海）软件有限公司。据悉，新成立的世嘉上海将作为加强世嘉在中国业务基础的基地，开展知识产权和内容推广及营销活动。 官方表示，中国作为全球领先的娱乐市场之一，其重要性日益凸显。这一趋势不仅体现在游戏等各类内容领域，授权和周边产品等IP业务领域也将持续增长。通过成立世嘉上海，世嘉旨在加深对本地市场的了解来加强合作伙伴关系并构建业务职能，从而在中国市场实现更大的业务增长。世嘉同时指出，将持续通过其遍布全球的开发工作室和业务基地，向尽可能多的人士提供精彩的内容，包括其自身的 IP 。

ja.summary: セガはこのほど、中国・上海にSega (Shanghai) Software Co., Ltd.を正式に設立したと発表した。新設されるセガ上海は、中国におけるセガの事業基盤を強化し、知的財産やコンテンツのプロモーション、マーケティング活動を行う拠点となると伝えられている。当局者らは、世界有数のエンターテインメント市場の一つとして、中国の重要性がますます顕著になっていると述べた。この傾向は、ゲームをはじめとするさまざまなコンテンツ分野だけでなく、ライセンスや周辺製品などのIPビジネス分野も今後も成長していきます。セガは、上海上海の設立により、現地市場への理解を深め、パートナーシップを強化し、中国市場でのさらなる事業成長に向けた事業機能の構築を目指します。また、セガは今後も、世界中の開発スタジオや事業拠点を通じて、自社IPを含む魅力的なコンテンツをより多くの人々に提供していく考えを示した。

en.title: Sega officially established Sega (Shanghai) Software Co., Ltd.
en.summary: Sega recently announced that it has officially established Sega (Shanghai) Software Co., Ltd. in Shanghai, China. It is reported that the newly established Sega Shanghai will serve as a base to strengthen Sega's business foundation in China and carry out intellectual property and content promotion and marketing activities. Officials said that as one of the world's leading entertainment markets, China's importance has become increasingly prominent. This trend is not only reflected in various content areas such as games, but also IP business areas such as licensing and peripheral products will continue to grow. By establishing Sega Shanghai, Sega aims to deepen its understanding of the local market to strengthen partnerships and build business functions to achieve greater business growth in the Chinese market. Sega also pointed out that it will continue to provide exciting content, including its own IP, to as many people as possible through its development studios and business bases around the world.

items.title: 沙特主权基金及财团收购EA案将于本周二完成
items.summary: 沙特阿拉伯主权财富基金、 银湖资本和 Affinity Partners 投资公司共同组成的投资者财团以550亿美元收购美国艺电公司（Electronic Arts）将于8月4日正式完成。此前，欧盟无条件批准了本次收购，也扫清了有史以来规模最大杠杆收购的最后障碍。 据悉，公司领导层和总部将保持不变。EA 将继续由首席执行官 Andrew Wilson 领导，办公地点也将继续设在加利福尼亚州雷德伍德城。据悉，沙特主权财富基金将保留其当前持股，并与两家美国投资机构共同注资支持此次收购。官方表示，此举旨在为EA带来长期资本、全球增长网络与战略支持，加速其在游戏、体育与娱乐领域的扩张。

ja.title: サウジ政府系ファンドとコンソーシアムによるEAの買収は火曜日に完了する
ja.summary: サウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、シルバー・レイク・キャピタル、アフィニティ・パートナーズで構成される投資家コンソーシアムによる550億米ドルによるエレクトロニック・アーツの買収は、8月4日に正式に完了する予定である。以前、EUはこの買収を無条件で承認し、史上最大のレバレッジド・バイアウトへの最後の障害をクリアした。同社の経営陣と本社には変更がないと報じられている。 EAは今後もCEOのアンドリュー・ウィルソン氏が率い、引き続きカリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティに拠点を置く。サウジ政府系ファンドは現在の保有株を維持し、買収を支援するために米国の投資機関２社と共同で資本注入すると報じられている。関係者らは、この動きはEAに長期資本、世界的な成長ネットワーク、戦略的支援をもたらし、ゲーム、スポーツ、エンターテインメントの分野での拡大を加速させることを目的としていると述べた。

en.title: The acquisition of EA by Saudi sovereign funds and consortia will be completed on Tuesday
en.summary: The US$55 billion acquisition of Electronic Arts by an investor consortium composed of Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund, Silver Lake Capital and Affinity Partners will be officially completed on August 4. Previously, the EU unconditionally approved the acquisition, clearing the final obstacle to the largest leveraged buyout in history. It is reported that the company's leadership and headquarters will remain unchanged. EA will continue to be led by CEO Andrew Wilson and will continue to be based in Redwood City, California. It is reported that the Saudi sovereign wealth fund will retain its current holdings and jointly inject capital with two U.S. investment institutions to support the acquisition. Officials stated that the move aims to bring long-term capital, global growth network and strategic support to EA to accelerate its expansion in the fields of games, sports and entertainment.

en.title: At the meeting, I finally learned how Brother Chui designed "Preface to the Sinking Star"
en.summary: On July 30, 2026, Jonathan Blow, the producer of "The Witness" and "Chrono", held a closed-door meeting for the media and core players during China Joy in Shanghai with his new work "Preface to the Falling Star". The trial demo of "Preface to the Sinking Star" was launched not long ago, and it has received praise from many players. This closed-door meeting was more like a conversation that was nearly ten years late. Since the launch of the project in 2016, "Preface to the Falling Star" has gone through a long process of self-developed engines, more than half of the levels have been overturned and redone, and the puzzles have been revised more than ten times. In the independent game circle, Chui Ge has always been known for his "uncompromising": he has bluntly said that many mainstream games are "wasting players' time", and as early as 2008, he sharply criticized some popular works as "immoral"; he has never concealed his rejection of commercial factors, believing that the last thing independent developers should give up is the persistence of personal expression.

en.title: The number of "one-person businesses" with annual sales exceeding 1.64 billion yen has tripled in two years with the support of AI

When the payment service Stripe analyzed the estimated index of one-person business operators created from the company's data, it was found that the number of businesses with annual sales of more than $10 million (approximately 1.64 billion yen) has increased approximately three times in the two years from 2023 to 2025. read more...

en.title: What is an efficient elevator algorithm?

zh.title: AI支持下的“反证Collat​​z猜想”无效，结果是基于Lean的内核bug

en.title: ``Disproof of Collatz's conjecture'' created with AI support is invalid, turns out to be based on Lean's kernel bug
en.summary: Although the ``proof that disproves the Collatz conjecture'' created with the help of AI was accepted by Lean, a theorem proving support system, it turned out that it actually exploited a flaw in the core of Lean. Leonardo de Moura, the developer of Lean, has published the history of the problem and explains that the proof is not mathematically valid. read more...

en.title: Technology that enables night vision goggles that can be seen in full color will be developed, but there are challenges in practical application
en.summary: A research team at Beijing Institute of Technology has developed a photoelectric conversion device that converts the wavelength and intensity of infrared light into the color and brightness of visible light, allowing humans to see infrared light in "full color." items.title: 中国の軍事研究者がOpenAIやAnthropicのAIモデルを抽出して国内の軍事システム開発に利用していたことが判明
items.summary: 中国の軍事研究者らが、OpenAIとAnthropicが開発したアメリカの主要なAIモデルの出力を利用して、中国の防衛能力を向上させるための国内AIシステムをトレーニングしていることが中国の学術論文および特許の調査から明らかになりました。アメリカ政府は中国への高度なチップ輸出規制やその他の戦略技術へのアクセスを制限していますが、中国のAI研究者らは「知識蒸留」と呼ばれる手法により、高性能なアメリカ製AIモデルの能力をより小型で安価な中国産モデルへ移し替えていたとみられています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 原来，中国军事研究人员从OpenAI和Anthropic中提取了AI模型，并将其用于国内军事系统开发

en.title: It turns out that Chinese military researchers extracted AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic and used them for domestic military system development
en.summary: Chinese military researchers are using the output of major American AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic to train domestic AI systems to improve China's defense capabilities, a review of Chinese academic papers and patents has revealed. Although the U.S. government imposes advanced chip export controls to China and restricts access to other strategic technologies, Chinese AI researchers are thought to have transferred the capabilities of high-performance American AI models to smaller, cheaper Chinese models using a method called ``knowledge distillation.'' read more...
